admission_protocol: Before CREATED is committed, preliminary session/run authority checks and one serialized budget reservation produce budget_reservation_event_id. The immutable RUN admission record cites it. Invalid proposals before reservation are audit rejections, not admitted RUNs. A later exact rehash/preclaim authority failure closes the admitted RUN as REJECTED_AUTHORITY; its reservation remains accounted.
attempt_rule: One execution-bearing attempt per RUN. Additional ATTEMPT_IDs may represent non-execution observation/reconciliation only under a closed schema and cannot create a second launch.
claim_rule: At most one authorized launch, no exactly-once external effect guarantee. Lost ack retrieves same committed claim for read-only inspection, never replays launch.
next_run_rule: A later RUN requires new RUN_ID, CLAIM_ID, ATTEMPT_ID, NAMESPACE_ID and independently issued RUN_AUTHORITY_ID; failed RUN remains addressable.
terminal_law: Append one terminal state and graph closure to a RUN; immutable admission and terminal records never rewritten. Later reconciliation is a distinct appended observation/decision. Terminal or consumed RUN cannot execute again.

transitions.guard: Immutable RUN admission already cites committed atomic budget reservation event; fresh IDs and separate RUN authority preliminarily validated.
